claim: Katsuki Bakugo's Quirk is Explosion.
explanation: Bakugo sweats a nitroglycerin-like substance that he can ignite to cause explosions.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Katsuki Bakugo

claim: Tsuyu Asui's hero name is Ribbit.
explanation: Tsuyu Asui's hero name is Froppy, not Ribbit.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tsuyu Asui

claim: Shoto Todoroki's Quirk is Half-Cold Half-Hot.
explanation: Todoroki can produce ice from his right side and flames from his left side.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Shoto Todoroki

claim: Shoto Todoroki inherited his ice side from his father, Endeavor.
explanation: His ice side comes from his mother, Rei Todoroki. His fire side comes from Endeavor.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Shoto Todoroki

claim: Tenya Iida's Quirk is Engine.
explanation: Iida's Engine Quirk gives him engines in his calves, which lets him run at high speed.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tenya Iida

claim: Tenya Iida's Quirk is named Jet.
explanation: Iida's Quirk is named Engine, not Jet.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tenya Iida

claim: All Might's Quirk is One For All.
explanation: One For All is the stockpiling Quirk that All Might inherited and later passed on to Izuku Midoriya.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - All Might

claim: All Might's Quirk is All For One.
explanation: All Might's Quirk is One For All. All For One is the Quirk of his enemy, All For One.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - All Might

claim: Shota Aizawa's Quirk is Erasure.
explanation: Aizawa's Erasure Quirk lets him cancel another person's Quirk while he is looking at them.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Shota Aizawa

claim: Shota Aizawa's hero name is Present Mic.
explanation: Aizawa's hero name is Eraser Head. Present Mic is the hero name of Hizashi Yamada.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Shota Aizawa

claim: Present Mic's Quirk is Voice.
explanation: Hizashi Yamada, known as Present Mic, has the Voice Quirk, which lets him produce extremely powerful sound.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Hizashi Yamada

claim: Eijiro Kirishima's Quirk is Hardening.
explanation: Kirishima's Hardening Quirk lets him harden his body, which gives him strong offense and defense.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Eijiro Kirishima

claim: Minoru Mineta's Quirk is Pop Off.
explanation: Mineta's Pop Off Quirk lets him pull sticky balls from his scalp and throw them.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Minoru Mineta

claim: Katsuki Bakugo is the class representative of Class 1-A.
explanation: Tenya Iida is Class 1-A's class representative, with Momo Yaoyorozu as vice representative.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tenya Iida

claim: Izuku Midoriya's hero name is Dynamight.
explanation: Dynamight is Katsuki Bakugo's hero name. Midoriya's hero name is Deku.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Izuku Midoriya

claim: Izuku Midoriya inherits One For All as its ninth holder.
explanation: All Might was the eighth holder of One For All, and he passes it to Midoriya, who becomes the ninth.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: Izuku Midoriya inherits One For All as its seventh holder.
explanation: Midoriya is the ninth holder of One For All. All Might was the eighth.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: The giant robot in the U.A. entrance exam is worth zero points.
explanation: The 0-point robot is an obstacle that awards no points, so students are meant to avoid it.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - U.A. High School

claim: The U.A. entrance exam includes a robot worth five points.
explanation: The exam robots are worth one, two or three points, plus the 0-point robot. No robot is worth five points.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - U.A. High School

claim: Ochaco Uraraka's Quirk, Zero Gravity, makes whatever she touches weightless.
explanation: Uraraka's fingertips can make objects float, and overuse makes her nauseous.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Ochaco Uraraka

claim: Ochaco Uraraka's Quirk makes whatever she touches heavier.
explanation: Uraraka's Zero Gravity removes the weight of what she touches. It does not add weight.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Ochaco Uraraka

claim: Shota Aizawa's threat to expel the last-place student in the Quirk Apprehension Test is a ruse.
explanation: Aizawa admits afterward that the threat was a rational deception meant to draw out the students' full potential.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Quirk Apprehension Test

claim: Momo Yaoyorozu places first overall in the Quirk Apprehension Test.
explanation: Yaoyorozu has the highest total score in the test, ahead of Shoto Todoroki in second place.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Quirk Apprehension Test

claim: Katsuki Bakugo places first overall in the Quirk Apprehension Test.
explanation: Momo Yaoyorozu places first. Bakugo places third.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Quirk Apprehension Test

claim: Class 1-A has twenty students.
explanation: Class 1-A has twenty students at the start of the series.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Class 1-A

claim: Class 1-A has twenty-two students.
explanation: Class 1-A has twenty students, not twenty-two.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Class 1-A

claim: Momo Yaoyorozu is the vice class representative of Class 1-A.
explanation: Yaoyorozu becomes vice representative when Tenya Iida is chosen as class representative.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Momo Yaoyorozu

claim: Izuku Midoriya is the vice class representative of Class 1-A.
explanation: Momo Yaoyorozu is the vice representative. Midoriya is not.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Momo Yaoyorozu

claim: Mina Ashido's Quirk is Acid.
explanation: Ashido can secrete acid from her body, and she controls its strength.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Mina Ashido

claim: Hanta Sero's Quirk is Acid.
explanation: Sero's Quirk is Tape. Acid is Mina Ashido's Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Hanta Sero

claim: Hanta Sero's Quirk is Tape.
explanation: Sero can shoot tape from his elbows, which he uses for movement and for restraining others.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Hanta Sero

claim: Mezo Shoji's hero name is Tailman.
explanation: Shoji's hero name is Tentacole. Tailman is Mashirao Ojiro's hero name.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Mezo Shoji

claim: Mezo Shoji's Quirk is Dupli-Arms.
explanation: Shoji's Dupli-Arms Quirk lets him grow extra limbs and organs from his tentacle-like arms.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Mezo Shoji

claim: Toru Hagakure's Quirk is Anivoice.
explanation: Hagakure's Quirk is Invisibility. Anivoice is Koji Koda's Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Toru Hagakure

claim: Koji Koda's Quirk is Sugar Rush.
explanation: Koda's Quirk is Anivoice. Sugar Rush is Rikido Sato's Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Koji Koda

claim: If Yuga Aoyama fires his Navel Laser for too long, he gets a stomachache.
explanation: Aoyama's Navel Laser puts strain on his stomach, and firing it for too long gives him a stomachache.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Yuga Aoyama

claim: Yuga Aoyama can fire his Navel Laser indefinitely without side effects.
explanation: Aoyama's Navel Laser has a limit, and overuse gives him a stomachache.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Yuga Aoyama

claim: Rikido Sato must eat sugar to activate his Quirk.
explanation: Sato's Sugar Rush Quirk gets its power from sugar he eats, which boosts his strength for a limited time.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Rikido Sato

claim: Rikido Sato must eat salt to activate his Quirk.
explanation: Sato's Sugar Rush Quirk is powered by sugar, not salt.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Rikido Sato

claim: Koji Koda's Quirk, Anivoice, lets him communicate with animals.
explanation: Anivoice lets Koda talk with animals and have them follow his commands.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Koji Koda

claim: Koji Koda's Quirk lets him control plants.
explanation: Koda's Anivoice is about communicating with animals, not controlling plants.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Koji Koda

claim: Hizashi Yamada, Present Mic, teaches English at U.A. High School.
explanation: Present Mic is the English teacher at U.A. High School.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Hizashi Yamada

claim: Hizashi Yamada, Present Mic, teaches mathematics at U.A. High School.
explanation: Present Mic teaches English, not mathematics.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Hizashi Yamada

claim: Aizawa's Erasure Quirk requires him to see his target.
explanation: Erasure only works while Aizawa is looking at the target, and it stops when he blinks.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Shota Aizawa

claim: Aizawa's Erasure Quirk works through physical touch.
explanation: Erasure works through eye contact with the target, not through touch.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Shota Aizawa

claim: Shoto Todoroki's scar was caused by boiling water thrown by his mother, Rei.
explanation: Rei Todoroki threw boiling water at Shoto, which left the scar around his left eye.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Shoto Todoroki

claim: Shoto Todoroki's scar was caused by his father, Endeavor.
explanation: The scar came from boiling water thrown by his mother, Rei, not from Endeavor.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Shoto Todoroki

claim: Fumikage Tokoyami's Dark Shadow is stronger in darkness and weaker in light.
explanation: Dark Shadow grows stronger and more aggressive in dark places and weaker in bright light.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Fumikage Tokoyami

claim: Fumikage Tokoyami's Dark Shadow grows stronger in bright light.
explanation: Dark Shadow is weaker in bright light and stronger in darkness.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Fumikage Tokoyami

claim: Denki Kaminari's hero name is Pinky.
explanation: Kaminari's hero name is Chargebolt. Pinky is Mina Ashido's hero name.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Denki Kaminari

claim: Tomura Shigaraki leads the League of Villains.
explanation: Shigaraki is the leader of the League of Villains, the group he builds around his goals.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tomura Shigaraki

claim: All For One is the Number One Hero.
explanation: All For One is the main villain of the series and All Might's greatest enemy, not a hero.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - All For One

claim: Stain is known as the Hero Killer.
explanation: Stain is a villain nicknamed the Hero Killer because he attacks heroes he judges unworthy of the title.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Stain

claim: Dabi's Quirk is Ice.
explanation: Dabi uses blue flames, not ice, and his Quirk is Cremation.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Dabi

claim: Himiko Toga's Quirk is Transform.
explanation: Toga's Transform Quirk lets her take on the appearance of a person after she ingests their blood.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Himiko Toga

claim: Kurogiri's Quirk is Compress.
explanation: Kurogiri's Quirk is Warp Gate. Compress is Mr. Compress's Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Kurogiri

claim: Re-Destro is the leader of the Meta Liberation Army.
explanation: Re-Destro leads the Meta Liberation Army, a group that campaigns for the freedom to use Quirks.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Re-Destro

claim: Mr. Compress is a member of the Meta Liberation Army.
explanation: Mr. Compress is a member of the League of Villains, not of the Meta Liberation Army.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Mr. Compress

claim: Twice's Quirk is Double.
explanation: Twice's Double Quirk lets him create copies of himself and of other objects.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Twice

claim: Spinner's Quirk is Warp Gate.
explanation: Spinner's Quirk is Gecko. Warp Gate belongs to Kurogiri.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Spinner

claim: Shigaraki's Quirk, Decay, disintegrates whatever he touches with all five fingers.
explanation: Decay breaks down what Shigaraki grips with all five fingers, and the effect spreads from the point of contact.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tomura Shigaraki

claim: Tomura Shigaraki's Quirk is Overhaul.
explanation: Shigaraki's Quirk is Decay. Overhaul is the Quirk of Kai Chisaki.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tomura Shigaraki

claim: Kurogiri is revealed to be Oboro Shirakumo, a former friend of Shota Aizawa.
explanation: Kurogiri is revealed to be Oboro Shirakumo, who was Aizawa's friend before his supposed death.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Kurogiri

claim: Kurogiri is revealed to be a former classmate of Endeavor.
explanation: Kurogiri is revealed to be Oboro Shirakumo, a former friend of Shota Aizawa, not a classmate of Endeavor.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Kurogiri

claim: Stain's Quirk is Bloodcurdle.
explanation: Stain's Bloodcurdle Quirk paralyzes a person after he ingests their blood.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Stain

claim: Stain's Quirk is Erasure.
explanation: Stain's Quirk is Bloodcurdle. Erasure is Shota Aizawa's Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Stain

claim: Overhaul's Quirk lets him disassemble and reassemble what he touches.
explanation: Overhaul, Kai Chisaki's Quirk, breaks matter down and puts it back together in a new form.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Kai Chisaki

claim: Kai Chisaki's Quirk is Rewind.
explanation: Chisaki's Quirk is Overhaul. Rewind is Eri's Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Kai Chisaki

claim: Eri's Quirk is Rewind.
explanation: Eri's Rewind Quirk lets her return a person's body to an earlier state.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Eri

claim: Eri's Quirk is Overhaul.
explanation: Eri's Quirk is Rewind. Overhaul is Kai Chisaki's Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Eri

claim: Gentle Criminal's Quirk is Elasticity.
explanation: Gentle Criminal uses Elasticity to give objects bounce and stretch.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Gentle Criminal

claim: Gentle Criminal's Quirk is Warp Gate.
explanation: Gentle Criminal's Quirk is Elasticity. Warp Gate belongs to Kurogiri.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Gentle Criminal

claim: La Brava's Quirk is Love.
explanation: La Brava's Love Quirk strengthens the Quirk of someone she loves.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - La Brava

claim: La Brava's Quirk is Hardening.
explanation: La Brava's Quirk is Love. Hardening is Eijiro Kirishima's Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - La Brava

claim: Re-Destro's Quirk is Stress.
explanation: Re-Destro's Stress Quirk gives him more power as his stress level rises.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Re-Destro

claim: Re-Destro's Quirk is Compress.
explanation: Re-Destro's Quirk is Stress. Compress is Mr. Compress's Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Re-Destro

claim: Muscular's Quirk is Muscle Augmentation.
explanation: Muscular's Muscle Augmentation Quirk lets him grow and strengthen his muscles.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Muscular

claim: Muscular's Quirk is Hardening.
explanation: Muscular's Quirk is Muscle Augmentation. Hardening is Kirishima's Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Muscular

claim: Lady Nagant's Quirk is Rifle.
explanation: Lady Nagant's Rifle Quirk lets her turn her arm into a firearm and fire projectiles.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Lady Nagant

claim: Lady Nagant's Quirk is Explosion.
explanation: Lady Nagant's Quirk is Rifle. Explosion is Katsuki Bakugo's Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Lady Nagant

claim: Kyudai Garaki is the scientist who developed the Nomu.
explanation: Kyudai Garaki, also called Doctor, is the scientist behind the Nomu program, and he works with All For One.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Kyudai Garaki

claim: Kyudai Garaki is a Pro Hero.
explanation: Garaki is a villain scientist allied with All For One, not a Pro Hero.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Kyudai Garaki

claim: The Paranormal Liberation Front was formed by the merger of the League of Villains and the Meta Liberation Army.
explanation: The Paranormal Liberation Front comes from the League of Villains absorbing the Meta Liberation Army.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Paranormal Liberation Front

claim: The Paranormal Liberation Front was formed by the merger of the League of Villains and the Shie Hassaikai.
explanation: The Paranormal Liberation Front was formed from the League of Villains and the Meta Liberation Army, not the Shie Hassaikai.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Paranormal Liberation Front

claim: Dabi is revealed to be Toya Todoroki, the eldest son of Endeavor.
explanation: Dabi is revealed to be Toya Todoroki, Endeavor's eldest son and Shoto's older brother.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Dabi

claim: The first user of One For All was All For One's younger brother.
explanation: Yoichi Shigaraki, All For One's younger brother, was the first holder of One For All.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: All For One is the younger brother of the first user of One For All.
explanation: The relationship is reversed: the first user of One For All was All For One's younger brother.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - All For One

claim: Hawks infiltrated the League of Villains on the orders of the Hero Public Safety Commission.
explanation: Hawks worked as an agent for the Hero Public Safety Commission and infiltrated the villains as a double agent.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Hawks

claim: Hawks is a member of the Meta Liberation Army.
explanation: Hawks is a Pro Hero who works with the Hero Public Safety Commission, not a member of the Meta Liberation Army.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Hawks

claim: Tomura Shigaraki's birth name is Tenko Shimura.
explanation: Shigaraki was born Tenko Shimura and is the grandson of Nana Shimura.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tomura Shigaraki

claim: Tomura Shigaraki is the biological son of Nana Shimura.
explanation: Shigaraki is Nana Shimura's grandson, not her son.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tomura Shigaraki

claim: Nana Shimura was a holder of One For All.
explanation: Nana Shimura was the seventh holder of One For All, before All Might.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Nana Shimura

claim: Stain attacked the hero Ingenium, Tensei Iida, and left him paralyzed.
explanation: Stain attacked Ingenium, which left him with a spinal injury and ended his hero career.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Stain

claim: Ingenium, the hero attacked by Stain, is Tenya Iida's father.
explanation: Ingenium is Tensei Iida, Tenya's older brother, not his father.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tensei Iida

claim: Twice's real name is Jin Bubaigawara.
explanation: Jin Bubaigawara is the real name of Twice, a member of the League of Villains.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Twice

claim: Twice's real name is Shuichi Iguchi.
explanation: Shuichi Iguchi is Spinner's real name. Twice's is Jin Bubaigawara.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Twice

claim: Spinner's real name is Shuichi Iguchi.
explanation: Shuichi Iguchi is Spinner's real name, and he is a member of the League of Villains.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Spinner

claim: Spinner's real name is Atsuhiro Sako.
explanation: Atsuhiro Sako is Mr. Compress's real name. Spinner's is Shuichi Iguchi.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Spinner

claim: Himiko Toga's Transform works by touching her target.
explanation: Toga's Transform requires her to ingest the target's blood, not just touch them.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Himiko Toga

claim: Gentle Criminal and La Brava are members of the League of Villains.
explanation: Gentle Criminal and La Brava are independent villains and are not members of the League of Villains.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Gentle Criminal

claim: Endeavor's Quirk is Hellflame.
explanation: Endeavor's Quirk is Hellflame, which lets him generate and control intense flames.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Endeavor

claim: Endeavor's Quirk is Cremation.
explanation: Endeavor's Quirk is Hellflame. Cremation is Dabi's Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Endeavor

claim: Hawks' Quirk is Fierce Wings.
explanation: Fierce Wings gives Hawks red wings made of feathers, which he uses for flight and attacks.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Hawks

claim: Hawks' Quirk is Dark Shadow.
explanation: Hawks' Quirk is Fierce Wings. Dark Shadow is Fumikage Tokoyami's Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Hawks

claim: Best Jeanist's Quirk is Fiber Master.
explanation: Fiber Master lets Best Jeanist control fibers, such as those in clothing.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Best Jeanist

claim: Best Jeanist's Quirk is Stress.
explanation: Best Jeanist's Quirk is Fiber Master. Stress is Re-Destro's Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Best Jeanist

claim: Mirko's Quirk is Rabbit.
explanation: Mirko's Rabbit Quirk gives her rabbit-like traits, including powerful legs.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Mirko

claim: Mirko's Quirk is Frog.
explanation: Mirko's Quirk is Rabbit. Frog is Tsuyu Asui's Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Mirko

claim: One For All is a Quirk that can be passed from one person to another.
explanation: One For All is a stockpiling Quirk that holders hand down to a chosen successor.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: One For All lets its holder steal Quirks from other people.
explanation: Stealing Quirks is the power of All For One. One For All is a stockpiling Quirk that is passed down.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: All For One can steal Quirks and give them to other people.
explanation: All For One's Quirk lets him take Quirks from others and transfer them to other people.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - All For One

claim: All For One can only give Quirks to others and cannot steal them.
explanation: All For One can both steal Quirks from others and give them out.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - All For One

claim: Full Cowl spreads One For All's power throughout Izuku Midoriya's body.
explanation: Full Cowl lets Midoriya use One For All's power across his whole body at a level he can control.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: Full Cowl concentrates One For All's power into a single limb.
explanation: Full Cowl distributes the power across the whole body. Concentrating it in one limb is the approach Midoriya starts with.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: Izuku Midoriya badly injures himself when he first uses One For All at full power.
explanation: His body cannot yet handle the power, so his first full-power uses in the entrance exam break his limbs.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Izuku Midoriya

claim: Izuku Midoriya can use One For All at full power safely from the start.
explanation: Midoriya's body is not ready for it at first, and full-power use injures him until he learns to control it.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Izuku Midoriya

claim: One For All is transferred by the successor ingesting the holder's DNA.
explanation: Midoriya inherits One For All by eating All Might's hair, which carries his DNA.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: One For All is transferred by a handshake.
explanation: The transfer works by the successor ingesting the holder's DNA, as with All Might's hair. A handshake does not transfer it.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: Blackwhip appears as black tendrils from Izuku Midoriya's body.
explanation: Blackwhip is one of the Quirks inside One For All, and Midoriya uses it as black tendrils that restrain and strike.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Izuku Midoriya

claim: Blackwhip appears as fire released from Izuku Midoriya's body.
explanation: Blackwhip appears as black tendrils, not fire.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Izuku Midoriya

claim: Danger Sense warns Izuku Midoriya of nearby threats.
explanation: Danger Sense is a Quirk inside One For All that alerts Midoriya to danger nearby.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Izuku Midoriya

claim: Danger Sense lets Izuku Midoriya turn invisible.
explanation: Danger Sense warns Midoriya of threats and does not make him invisible.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Izuku Midoriya

claim: Float is one of the Quirks Izuku Midoriya can use through One For All.
explanation: Float lets Midoriya levitate, and it is one of the past holders' Quirks inside One For All.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Izuku Midoriya

claim: Smokescreen lets Izuku Midoriya produce ice.
explanation: Smokescreen produces smoke. It does not produce ice.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Izuku Midoriya

claim: Momo Yaoyorozu's Creation produces objects from lipids in her own body.
explanation: Creation turns the fat in Yaoyorozu's body into objects, so she has to eat to keep using it.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Momo Yaoyorozu

claim: Momo Yaoyorozu's Creation makes objects from materials taken from her surroundings.
explanation: Creation draws on lipids in Yaoyorozu's own body, not on her surroundings.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Momo Yaoyorozu

claim: Katsuki Bakugo's explosions grow stronger the more he sweats.
explanation: Bakugo's explosions come from his sweat, so more sweat produces stronger blasts.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Katsuki Bakugo

claim: Katsuki Bakugo's explosions grow stronger when he is completely dry.
explanation: Bakugo's explosions are fueled by his sweat, so they are stronger when he sweats more, not when he is dry.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Katsuki Bakugo

claim: Tenya Iida's Recipro Burst gives him a temporary speed boost.
explanation: Recipro Burst gives Iida a short burst of speed and leaves his engines stalled afterward.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tenya Iida

claim: Tenya Iida's Recipro Burst gives him a permanent speed boost.
explanation: Recipro Burst is a temporary boost, and his engines stall once it ends.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tenya Iida

claim: Ochaco Uraraka's Zero Gravity can make her nauseous if she exceeds her weight limit.
explanation: If Uraraka floats more weight than she can handle, she suffers nausea.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Ochaco Uraraka

claim: Ochaco Uraraka's Zero Gravity affects any object regardless of weight with no side effects.
explanation: Zero Gravity has a weight limit, and going over it makes Uraraka nauseous.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Ochaco Uraraka

claim: Overusing his ice side lowers Shoto Todoroki's body temperature.
explanation: Heavy use of his ice side chills Todoroki's body, and he warms up with his fire side.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Shoto Todoroki

claim: Overusing his ice side overheats Shoto Todoroki.
explanation: Overusing his ice side lowers Todoroki's body temperature. Overheating is the risk of his fire side.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Shoto Todoroki

claim: Tomura Shigaraki's Decay awakened when his family died.
explanation: Shigaraki's Quirk awakened in childhood, and his family was killed by Decay.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tomura Shigaraki

claim: Izuku Midoriya can use the Quirks of previous One For All holders.
explanation: Past holders' Quirks are inside One For All, and Midoriya awakens them over the course of the story.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: The Quirks of previous One For All holders vanish when One For All is passed on.
explanation: The past holders' Quirks remain inside One For All and become available to later holders.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: Fa Jin stores kinetic energy that can be released in a powerful strike.
explanation: Fa Jin, one of the Quirks inside One For All, builds up kinetic energy and releases it in an attack.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Izuku Midoriya

claim: Fa Jin lets Izuku Midoriya change his body shape.
explanation: Fa Jin stores and releases kinetic energy. It does not change his body shape.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Izuku Midoriya

claim: Endeavor's Hellflame burns hotter as his body temperature rises.
explanation: Hellflame's heat increases with Endeavor's body temperature, and that limits how long he can fight.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Endeavor

claim: Endeavor's Hellflame burns hottest when his body is cold.
explanation: Hellflame gets hotter as Endeavor's body temperature rises, not when he is cold.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Endeavor

claim: Hawks can control his feathers after they detach from his wings.
explanation: Fierce Wings lets Hawks command detached feathers, which he uses to attack and for other purposes.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Hawks

claim: Hawks can only use his feathers while they are attached to his wings.
explanation: Hawks can control his feathers after they detach.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Hawks

claim: A child's Quirk is usually inherited from one or both parents.
explanation: In the series, Quirks are typically passed down from parents, and a child's Quirk may combine parental traits.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Quirk

claim: A Quirk's strength can never be improved through training.
explanation: Many characters strengthen their Quirks through training, as Class 1-A does at U.A.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Quirk

claim: Izuku Midoriya can use Full Cowl at different percentage levels of One For All's power.
explanation: Midoriya raises the percentage of One For All he can use in Full Cowl as he trains.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: One For All is a stockpiling Quirk whose power grows as it is passed down.
explanation: Each holder adds to the power stockpiled in One For All before passing it on.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: Tomura Shigaraki's Decay works only on living organisms.
explanation: Decay breaks down inanimate matter such as buildings as well as living beings.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tomura Shigaraki

claim: One For All was created by the Hero Public Safety Commission.
explanation: One For All originated with Yoichi Shigaraki, the younger brother of All For One, not the Commission.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: Mirko's Rabbit Quirk allows her to fly.
explanation: Mirko's Rabbit Quirk gives her powerful legs for jumping and kicking, but it does not give her flight.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Mirko

claim: Izuku Midoriya was born Quirkless before he inherited One For All from All Might.
explanation: Izuku begins the story without a Quirk and receives One For All from All Might.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Izuku Midoriya

claim: All Might is the ninth holder of One For All.
explanation: All Might is the eighth holder of One For All. Izuku Midoriya is the ninth.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: Nana Shimura, the seventh holder of One For All, is Tomura Shigaraki's grandmother.
explanation: Nana Shimura passed One For All to All Might. She is the grandmother of Tenko Shimura, who becomes Tomura Shigaraki.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Nana Shimura

claim: Nana Shimura is Tomura Shigaraki's maternal grandmother.
explanation: Nana is his paternal grandmother. She is the mother of his father, Kotaro Shimura.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tomura Shigaraki

claim: Tomura Shigaraki's birth name is Tenko Shimura.
explanation: Shigaraki was born Tenko Shimura, and his Decay Quirk awakened in childhood.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tomura Shigaraki

claim: Dabi is revealed to be Shoto Todoroki's younger brother.
explanation: Dabi is Toya Todoroki, Endeavor's eldest son, which makes him Shoto's older brother.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Dabi

claim: Dabi's body cannot withstand the heat of his own Blueflame, which is why he is covered in burn scars.
explanation: Toya inherited powerful fire but his body could not endure its heat, so his own flames burn him.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Dabi

claim: Shoto Todoroki inherits his ice from Endeavor and his fire from his mother, Rei.
explanation: It is the reverse. Shoto's fire comes from Endeavor's Hellflame and his ice comes from Rei.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Shoto Todoroki

claim: Shoto Todoroki uses ice on his right side and fire on his left side.
explanation: His Half-Cold Half-Hot Quirk produces ice from the right half of his body and flames from the left.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Shoto Todoroki

claim: Shoto Todoroki's scar around his left eye was inflicted by Endeavor.
explanation: The scar was caused by his mother, Rei, who burned him with boiling water in a breakdown triggered by Endeavor's abuse.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Shoto Todoroki

claim: Hawks's Quirk, Fierce Wings, lets him control his feathers individually.
explanation: Hawks's red wings are made of feathers he can detach and steer independently in flight and combat.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Hawks

claim: Hawks is the Number One hero when the Paranormal Liberation War begins.
explanation: Endeavor became the Number One hero after All Might's retirement, and Hawks ranks below him.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Hawks

claim: Kai Chisaki, known as Overhaul, can disassemble and reassemble matter with his Quirk.
explanation: Overhaul's Quirk lets him break objects and people apart and rebuild them in a different form.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Kai Chisaki

claim: The Quirk-destroying bullets developed by Shie Hassaikai were made from Overhaul's own blood.
explanation: They were made from the blood of Eri, whose Rewind Quirk was used to produce the Quirk-destroying drug.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Eri

claim: Eri's Quirk, Rewind, can return a person's body to an earlier state.
explanation: Rewind reverts a person to a prior condition, which is why Overhaul exploited her.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Eri

claim: Eri's Quirk is Healing rather than Rewind.
explanation: Eri's Quirk is Rewind, which reverts a body to an earlier state. It is not a healing Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Eri

claim: Kurogiri was originally a person named Oboro Shirakumo.
explanation: Kurogiri is revealed to be Oboro Shirakumo, a former U.A. student and friend of Shota Aizawa.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Kurogiri

claim: Kurogiri was originally Shota Aizawa's brother.
explanation: Kurogiri was Oboro Shirakumo, a friend and classmate of Aizawa, not his brother.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Kurogiri

claim: Himiko Toga's Quirk, Transform, requires her to ingest a person's blood.
explanation: Toga drinks blood to change into the person she took it from.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Himiko Toga

claim: Twice's Quirk is called Replicate.
explanation: Twice's Quirk is called Double, and it lets him create copies of people and objects.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Twice

claim: Mr. Compress's Quirk stores objects inside glass cubes.
explanation: Mr. Compress compresses objects and people into small glass marbles, not cubes.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Mr. Compress

claim: Spinner's Quirk is Lizard.
explanation: Spinner's Quirk is Gecko, which gives him adhesion and mutant gecko-like traits.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Spinner

claim: Star and Stripe is Cathleen Bate, the Number One hero of the United States.
explanation: Cathleen Bate is the American Number One hero who fights alongside the Japanese heroes against All For One.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Star and Stripe

claim: Star and Stripe is Japan's Number One hero.
explanation: Star and Stripe is the Number One hero of the United States, not Japan.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Star and Stripe

claim: Star and Stripe's Quirk is named New Order.
explanation: Cathleen Bate's Quirk is called New Order.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Star and Stripe

claim: Gran Torino's Quirk is Jet.
explanation: Sorahiko Torino uses a Jet Quirk to propel himself with high-speed bursts from his legs.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Gran Torino

claim: Gran Torino's Quirk is Warp.
explanation: Gran Torino's Quirk is Jet. Warp Gate is Kurogiri's Quirk.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Gran Torino

claim: Sir Nighteye's Quirk is Foresight.
explanation: Nighteye can see a glimpse of a person's future by making contact with them.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Sir Nighteye

claim: Sir Nighteye survives the fight against Overhaul and later retires.
explanation: Nighteye was fatally wounded in the fight against Overhaul and died from his injuries.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Sir Nighteye

claim: Stain's Quirk is Bloodcurdle.
explanation: Stain can paralyze a person after tasting their blood.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Stain

claim: Stain is never captured after the Hosu incident.
explanation: Stain was arrested by the heroes after the Hosu incident.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Stain

claim: Tensei Iida, Ingenium, is left unable to continue hero work after being injured by Stain.
explanation: Stain's attack left Ingenium with a serious spinal injury that forced him to stop active hero work.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Tensei Iida

claim: All For One and Yoichi Shigaraki are brothers.
explanation: All For One and Yoichi are brothers, and Yoichi is the first holder of One For All.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - All For One

claim: Yoichi Shigaraki is All For One's son.
explanation: Yoichi is All For One's brother, not his son.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - All For One

claim: Yoichi Shigaraki was the first holder of One For All.
explanation: One For All originates with Yoichi Shigaraki and is passed down through his successors.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: All Might was the first holder of One For All.
explanation: All Might is the eighth holder. The first holder was Yoichi Shigaraki.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: Endeavor and Rei's marriage was a Quirk marriage arranged to create a child with both fire and ice.
explanation: Endeavor married Rei specifically to produce a child inheriting both fire and ice, which led to Shoto.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Enji Todoroki

claim: Endeavor and Rei had a marriage based on love.
explanation: Their marriage was a Quirk marriage arranged for Endeavor's goal of surpassing All Might.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Enji Todoroki

claim: Fuyumi Todoroki is Shoto Todoroki's older sister.
explanation: Fuyumi is one of Shoto's older siblings, along with Natsuo and Toya.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Fuyumi Todoroki

claim: Natsuo Todoroki is Shoto Todoroki's younger brother.
explanation: Natsuo is Shoto's older brother. Shoto is the youngest of the Todoroki siblings.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Natsuo Todoroki

claim: Dabi publicly reveals his identity as Toya Todoroki and exposes Endeavor's past during the Paranormal Liberation War.
explanation: Dabi announces his identity as Endeavor's son and exposes Endeavor's abusive past to the public.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Dabi

claim: Izuku Midoriya dies during the final battle against Tomura Shigaraki.
explanation: Izuku survives the final battle and the story continues into the epilogue.
source_name: VIZ Media - My Hero Academia

claim: At the end of the manga, Izuku Midoriya no longer possesses One For All.
explanation: After the final conflict, One For All is gone and Izuku is Quirkless again, though he remains a hero.
source_name: VIZ Media - My Hero Academia

claim: All Might regains One For All after the final battle.
explanation: One For All is not restored to All Might. By the ending, the power is gone entirely.
source_name: VIZ Media - My Hero Academia

claim: Izuku's first use of Full Cowl is at 5 percent of One For All's power.
explanation: When Izuku first masters Full Cowl, he can sustain it at only 5 percent and increases the output with training.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Izuku Midoriya

claim: Izuku first masters Full Cowl at 45 percent power.
explanation: He first masters Full Cowl at 5 percent. Higher percentages come later through training.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - Izuku Midoriya

claim: Izuku can use Float, a Quirk that belonged to a previous holder of One For All.
explanation: Izuku gains access to the Float Quirk of a previous One For All holder after the vestiges awaken.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: Izuku's Blackwhip Quirk was obtained from All For One.
explanation: Blackwhip comes from a previous holder of One For All, not All For One.
source_name: My Hero Academia Wiki - One For All

claim: Mei Hatsume is a student in U.A.'s Support Course.
explanation: Mei Hatsume studies in the Support Course and builds the equipment she calls her babies.
source_name: VIZ Media - My Hero Academia

claim: Mei Hatsume is in U.A.'s Hero Course.
explanation: Mei is in the Support Course, not the Hero Course.
source_name: VIZ Media - My Hero Academia
